title: CERTCRYPT Verification Package (verification-package/1)
description: The JSON form of a verification_package, as verification-package/1 §9.4 and §22.1 fix it: one object with a closed member set. Passing this schema is necessary, not sufficient: the rules a schema cannot express are listed in `$comment` and decided by the verifier.
$comment: Not expressible here and enforced by a conformant verifier: (1) no object at any depth repeats a member name (verifier-toolkit/1 §7.2); (2) verification_context names exactly the system_id and rules_version of the certificate's signed payload and, when present, of the independence_proof (verification-package/1 §13); (3) settlement_reference, when present, equals the independence_proof's settlement_ref and requires an independence_proof; (4) each artifact member is valid under its own specification (CCSP/1, independence.proof/1, capacity.evidence/1, settlement.binding/1 §7, settlement-material/1), and the artifacts belong to one certificate, one leaf and one settlement context.

base_certificate.description: The issuer-emitted CCSP/1 certificate being verified. Its own shape is base-certificate.schema.json.

verification_context.description: The rules version and system domain the package is evaluated under, repeated from the artifacts it carries.

rules_version.description: The rules version the certificate and the proof name.

system_id.description: The system domain the certificate and the proof name.

independence_proof.description: The independence.proof/1 artifact. Required for Independent verification.

capacity_evidence.description: The capacity.evidence/1 evidence of the certificate's commitment (zero-data path).

commitment_inclusion_proof.description: The per-commitment inclusion path of settlement.binding/1 §7, from the certificate's commitment to the proof's subtree_root.

commitment_id.description: The commitment's identifier: on the zero-data path, the digest of its capacity evidence.

commitment_leaf_hash.description: The commitment leaf hash, recomputed by the verifier from commitment_id.

commitment_index.description: The commitment's position in the leaf's sub-tree.

subtree_size.description: The number of commitments in the sub-tree; greater than commitment_index.

settlement_material.description: The leaf's settlement material. Its own shape is settlement-material.schema.json.

settlement_reference.description: Optional copy of the independence_proof's settlement_ref. Carries no meaning of its own.
